decisions.reason: Retaining data during the new controlled redeployment does not entail restoring metadata from NFTs on the earlier legacy contract; the active-contract-only metadata policy remains valid.
The redeployment strategy preserves existing data but does not require the dashboard to render NFTs from the earlier legacy contract or otherwise change media-rendering behavior.
The migration decision does not change the Transak flow, and its active-replacement-contract mint scope remains applicable after a controlled redeployment.
The source changes how contract fixes are deployed and data retained, not the USDC mint behavior or its active-contract scope.
The controlled redeployment does not alter the NFT ebook format, unlimited supply, or the requirement that new mints use the active contract.
